caption: The drawing depicts a scene reminiscent of a bowling or skittles game, featuring a brown, silhouetted figure of a person wearing a hat and holding a ball in their right hand, positioned on the left side of the composition. The person is shown mid-stride, facing to the right. The ground beneath the figure appears as a narrow, rectangular strip shaded in shades of brown and gray. To the right of the figure, near the center of the strip, stands a vertical pole topped with a round ball. Further to the right, four upright skittles or pins are positioned in a row at the end of the strip, all rendered in the same brownish tones as the figure and the base. The background is entirely plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
title: Bowling Weather Vane
